notes.title: Fan-chosen Ticket to Ride®: Heart of Africa Expansion Runs Wild!
notes.content:
💛🦒 You made it happen – Ticket to Ride®: Heart of Africa Expansion has arrived on Steam!

For the first time on digital platforms, explore the beautiful and varied landscape of Africa alongside new travel buddies Blessing Kipruto and Nnamdi Okpara. Plot your path, refine your strategy and become an expert at navigating tricky new terrain with the aptly named Terrain cards! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633384/54d49769ad6610d01f444f0cdce640728c080239.png"]
With careful planning, you can double your points on a completed route by using Heart of Africa’s three different Terrain cards:

🏜️ Desert and Savanna for yellow, orange and red routes

🌴 Jungle and Forest for purple, blue and green routes

⛰️ Mountain and Cliff for white, grey and black routes 



Customise your game with thematic vehicles, including the historic Fahagola railbus, the Safari Sights car and the Animal Trails or Stately Travels carriage.


Change your perspective with the all-new Landscape Mode too! Toggle this option in the map selection screen to play the Heart of Africa map whichever way you like. 



🗺️ Think you can plot a course through deserts, jungles and mountains? Add Ticket to Ride: Heart of Africa to your collection today and find out!

notes.title: Mastering Country-to-Country Tickets in Ticket to Ride®: Switzerland
notes.content:
Ticket to Ride®: Switzerland Expansion introduces an exciting new mechanic – country-to-country tickets. 

These tickets can mean big scores or deductions for players, so they need to be utilised effectively. Here are some tips and tricks to navigate the country-to-country tickets. 

🗺️ Identify hub cities
Take a look at the map and figure out which cities connect to multiple important destinations. For example, Zurich features on nine normal tickets and one of the four city-to-country tickets. 

🔒 Lock or block
Slow opponents down by blocking routes or locking them down for yourself! Shorter connections can make or break another player’s plans. 

⭕ Secure country nodes quickly
The bordering countries on the map have limited nodes, so if you’re aiming to complete a country-to-country ticket, make sure to grab the node you need early on. These routes also end at the country in question, making them a dead end; you’ll have to plan for that too!  

🎫 Be realistic with tickets
Country-to-country tickets can be a huge boost to your endgame total, but if you fail to complete them, they can also cost you the game. Consider where you are in the game before taking on a country-to-country ticket! 


How will you conquer the tricky country-to-country tickets? Share your winning strategies with us!

Ticket to Ride®: Switzerland Expansion arrives 10th December 2024.

notes.title: All Aboard for the First Ticket to Ride Discord Tournament! 🚂
notes.content:
Greetings Travellers!

It's time for the very first Ticket to Ride Discord Tournament! Get ready to showcase your strategic skills, compete against fellow players, and fight for the ultimate prize—a Round the World Ticket for the 1st place winner! 🌍🎟️

Finalists will also receive the prestigious Rail Master Discord role! 🤩 

🗓️ Date: August 9th
🕑 Time: 2 PM GMT+1
📅 Brackets: To be defined based on the number of registered players.
🗺️ Maps: All games will be played in the base USA map for this tournament.

📌 How it will work:

 Register: Click the register button in the Events channel of our Discord Server to secure your spot.

 Registration Deadline: Participants must register by 9am on August 9th GMT+1 to join the tournament.
 Tourney Bot: If necessary, we'll create several "events" for players to register, since the bot has a limit of 16 players per event. These will be tagged "Reg1", "Reg2", etc. Players will all be put together and shuffled in the end, so it doesn't matter which one you register in.
  
Brackets: Players will be divided into brackets and added to a private Discord Game Channel with their opponents. 
 Match Setup: Matches will be set up by one of the participants selected by the Admins. Players will then receive instructions on how to join the game.
 Match Reporting: Players must report their match results to the Admins immediately after each match

⛔ Rules:

 Fair Play: All participants are expected to play fairly and respectfully. Cheating, exploiting bugs, or any form of unsportsmanlike behaviour will result in disqualification.
 Respect: All participants must treat each other with respect. Harassment, abusive language, or any form of discrimination will not be tolerated.
 Punctuality: Players must be on time for their matches. Failure to appear within 10 minutes of the scheduled start time will result in a forfeit.
 Technical Difficulties: In the event of technical difficulties, players must immediately notify the Admins. The Admins will decide on a course of action.
 Violation of Rules: Any player found to be in violation of these rules will be disqualified from the tournament.
 Rule Changes: The organizers reserve the right to modify these rules at any time. Participants will be notified of any changes.


Don't miss out on this exciting event! Register now! 🚆🎉

notes.title: Top the Charts: Learn More About Leaderboards
notes.content:
Ready to prove you’re the ultimate railway master?

With the new Leaderboards feature, you can now build your rail empire while facing off against players worldwide in an epic race to the top. It's time to see if you have what it takes to dominate the tracks and claim your spot among the best! 

How It Works

In our game, stars determine your rank and position on the leaderboard. Let’s talk about how you can use them to climb the ranks and show off your skills! 

Ranked Games

Some game modes are now ‘ranked,’ meaning your performance in these modes will directly affect your rank, giving you stars each time you advance. You can earn stars on any map in single-player mode (for Single Player Leaderboard) and Online and Async modes (for Online Leaderboard). 

Stars and Games Won

After each match, you'll gain or lose stars based on your performance compared to your expected position. This expectation is calculated using your rank and the ranks of your opponents.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633384/bff5014a5ffa25e8c3cb9ffedb64df6f6c1c09ae.png
You can also lose stars if you don’t perform well. This means a player who wins most of their 20 games will rank much higher than someone who plays 100 games but loses most of them, especially if they lose against players with lower ranks.

Climbing the Leaderboards

As you collect stars, you'll hit new milestones and your rank gets a shiny upgrade. Everyone starts at Bronze, but you can move up through the tiers as you get better. The ultimate goal? Reaching the prestigious Diamond rank!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633384/0ef46c884c36de8f8172932c370e45cff6d6a2e6.png
Navigating Leaderboards

You can monitor your position on our Single-Player and Online leaderboards by navigating to the main menu's 'Leaderboards' section, which updates in real-time so you always know where you stand. The screen will display current season stats. 

Each new season will offer a fresh start, resetting ranks and giving everyone a new opportunity to reach the top! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633384/e3d50dd644f7d4acdd436bc3801b73312f4cb4cc.png
Upcoming Features and Improvements

Hall of Fame

At the end of each season, your stars will transfer to a Hall of Fame, ensuring that your efforts are recognised and not lost. To keep the competition fair and exciting, there will be a gradual decay in stars, giving new players a chance to compete.

Player Stats

We’re also considering adding a Statistics page where you can see your best-ever rank and star count. If there's enough demand, we might also provide access to the previous season’s data, but we will keep the community posted on this.

But it’s not all about numbers and ranks; it’s about pushing your limits and continuously improving. Whether you’re a seasoned player or a newcomer, the Leaderboards invite you to refine your strategies and reach new heights in Ticket to Ride!

Feel free to join us on Discord to share your feedback and suggestions and participate in events! We’re planning tournaments and many other exciting activities, and can’t wait to see you all there!

– Bella & Davi, Community Team

notes.title: Out Now: USA 1910, Europa 1912, Pass & Play and Leaderboards!
notes.content:
Hello, travellers! 

We’re super excited to bring you a fantastic update for Ticket to Ride! We’ve just released two brand-new Ticket Packs – USA 1910 and Europa 1912 – and added the highly anticipated Pass & Play and Leaderboards features. Also, we’ve made some improvements to the colours in the tracks and cards to make your experience even better.

We know you've been eagerly awaiting these additions, and we can't wait for you to try them with patch 1.3.0! Keep reading to learn more about each one of them. 

[hr][/hr]Ticket Packs

Ticket Packs enrich gameplay with additional cards, setting them apart from our regular expansions, which feature new maps, characters and trains. They are included as a bonus in the Round the World Ticket and will not impact the release of the eight further expansions we have planned for it. 

Let's take a look at what they bring to the game! 

USA 1910

Become a legend of American railroads! Travel back to 1910 and relive the golden age of railways with the USA 1910 Ticket Pack!

The pack contains 35 new Destination Tickets, an exciting Globetrotter Bonus card rewarding the completion of the most tickets and 4 Mystery Train Destination Tickets. Enjoy three new game modes – the standard USA 1910, Big Cities and the iconic Mega Game. Expand your railway empire and make history!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633384/df4a6270418c303cbc431e8172802ca2e0b20fa9.png

Europa 1912

Step into bustling historic cities with the Europa 1912 Ticket Pack and rewrite the history of your railway empire!

The pack brings you 55 new Destination Tickets that also unlock three new game modes. Experience Europe Expanded with 19 new routes, dive into Big Cities of Europe with tickets to 9 major cities or immerse yourself in Mega Europe, combining all the cards for the ultimate railway adventure!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633384/09abe2e50732c3f0ca591bf00f707e70f54c6875.png

🎁 Current owners of the Europe Expansion will receive the Europa 1912 Ticket Pack as a bonus! Going forward, this Ticket Pack will be included as part of the Europe Expansion for all new players.

[hr][/hr]Pass & Play

Enjoy Ticket to Ride with friends and family with the new Pass & Play feature on the same device. Take turns building your railway empire, making it easier than ever to enjoy the game together, no matter where you are.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633384/61b558293c9aee8775ce444acaff906078874644.png
[hr][/hr]Leaderboards

Compete against players worldwide and see how you stack up with the new leaderboards feature!

Your rank will build up from the first game you play after this update. This means everyone gets a fresh start from zero to ensure a fair game for all.

Track your progress, climb the ranks, and become the ultimate Ticket to Ride master!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633384/e827360508671bef1036f4feef37936ade8b3ee9.png
[hr][/hr]Visibility Improvements

We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear, and we know how important visibility is to you. As part of our ongoing visibility improvements, we’ve updated the card colours to perfectly match the track colors. 

We'd love to hear your thoughts! Share your feedback through a review or join our Community Hub. You can also hop on our Discord to stay updated with the latest news and connect with fellow travellers.

Choo choo! 🚂

– Bella & Davi, Community Team

notes.title: Available Now: Simplified Map and General Visibility Improvements!
notes.content:
You asked, and we delivered. As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance visibility in Ticket to Ride, we're excited to introduce a brand new way to navigate that's more intuitive and accessible than ever before.

A new, simplified map view, alongside numerous visibility improvements to the overall map design, is now officially LIVE!

What's New:

Simplified Map
Experience a new view of the game map that puts the focus on your strategy! The Simplified Map features a two-tone design that makes it easier to distinguish it from the tracks, along with new train token material and glow effects for improved visibility, all accessible through a convenient toggle function. Available across all map expansions, existing and future!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633384/0b4a8dfdcd8bc07e9e659198545c598d4516d5a5.png
Enabling the Simplified Map

You can toggle between map views directly from the game settings:

 Simply navigate to the ‘‘Settings’’ menu within the game.
 From there, you'll find the option to toggle the Simplified Map on or off with just a click. It's as easy as that!
And the best part? You can adjust this setting at any time during gameplay. You have full control over how you view your journey – whether you prefer scenic routes or express travel, the choice is yours! 

Enhanced Visibility (Default Map)

In addition to the Simplified Map, enjoy more playing space, increased clarity for map elements (including tracks and tokens), improved contrast with track shadows, and minimised visual effects in the default map for a more accessible yet immersive gameplay experience! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633384/307c7a04cb232662ef6dcb489433d40599140ed5.png
This is not our last stop. 

Continuous improvement is the core of our mission, and we're already working on more visibility enhancements for all the maps based on your input. 

We'd greatly appreciate it if you could take a moment to leave a review to let us know your thoughts. You can also join our Discord or Community Hub to chat directly with us and fellow players! Your feedback helps us understand what you love about the game and how we can make it even better.

See you on the tracks! 

Bella and Davi, Community Team

Hello travellers,

The railway adventure sprawls across to more platforms! Strategise, build your railway empire and conquer new horizons right from your Mac devices with our new update.

notes.content:
Hello travellers,

Today, we’re rolling out our latest patch update, which not only brings visibility improvements to the game across all platforms but also addresses stability and performance. This update includes:

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the game to get stuck after changing your screen resolution

notes.title: Map Visibility Improvements on the Horizon!
notes.content:
Hello, travellers,

As we approach Q2, we couldn't be happier to share some exciting news with you! 

Many of you have shared concerns about visibility issues, particularly regarding tracks and other elements on the Ticket to Ride maps. Simultaneously, others have praised the level of detail, dynamic animations, and immersive aspects of the current maps.

Having tried to accommodate both ends of the spectrum on a single map, we have reached the conclusion that any simplification takes away from the immersion that some of you like, and at the same time, the immersive direction takes away from the simplicity that an equally valuable segment of you prefer. 

As such, we have decided to introduce a second map and give you the option to toggle between the two. You will have the current immersive option, but also a simplified one to play with!

This new simplified map will offer a streamlined, user-friendly interface that makes it easier to see and understand the game board, without compromising on the strategic depth that Ticket to Ride is known for. This should not only address concerns related to colourblind accessibility but also ensure that every player can fully enjoy the game. We're aiming to release it this Q2 2024, and we'll do our best to ensure it meets your expectations.

We’d like to thank every member of our community who took the time to share their constructive feedback, as this has been invaluable in guiding us toward this exciting new phase of development.

Want to know more about what's coming next? 


Check out our roadmap and please continue to share your thoughts and suggestions in the Community Hub or contact help@marmalademail.com. 

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2477010/view/6967693077432829474

Want to be the first to get updates, meet new players and participate in discussions about Ticket to Ride? Join our Discord community!

– Bella & Davi, Community Team

notes.title: Ticket to Ride CEO Q&A: Your Questions Answered!
notes.content:
Hello, travellers!

We're back with the answers to the questions you sent in for our Ticket to Ride CEO Q&A. A huge thank you to everyone who took the time to participate and send their queries via Steam, Discord, email, and social media!

Let's jump right in and see what our CEOs, Cristina Mereuta and Michael Willis, had to say:

[hr][/hr]
1: Why are you charging us twice for the same game? When will you allow us to restore purchases of maps from the Classic Edition?
(Asked by asteiner, Babs5680, atlantic_workshop)

Marmalade have made a brand new game, built from the ground up, and completely reimagining what a Ticket to Ride video game could be. We are massive fans of both the physical board game and the Twin Sails digital version but thought there was an amazing opportunity to improve loads of things and bring this wonderful board game to a much wider audience as a brand new, immersive and more accessible video game. We offer a free upgrade to the Europe map for all owners of the Classic Edition but otherwise we are offering our game just like any other new game release.

However, perhaps in order to answer this question more fully, we should provide more context. Ticket to Ride Classic Edition was developed and published by Twin Sails/the old Asmodee Digital. About two years ago Asmodee came to the conclusion that it wasn’t going to be possible for them to continue developing and supporting the game long term. The old codebase made maintaining features or adding new features virtually impossible (e.g. players may remember the chat function was just removed rather than fixed, something we will bring back better than ever). Marmalade obviously played no part in Twin Sail’s decision to stop maintaining the old version or sunset the multiplayer.

Once Asmodee realised they couldn’t support the game anymore, they started looking for a developer and publisher who was passionate about the brand and willing to invest into making a new game from scratch and capable of bringing the digital Ticket to Ride experience up to date and ready for the next 10 years and beyond hopefully. We ended up being that developer and publisher and acquired the digital rights for Ticket to Ride. This presented us with a hugely exciting opportunity to build the game as a modern version that improves on the original. With a team of industry veterans and promising young talent, we have an impeccable 8 years long track record of making popular board games for various gaming platforms, topping the charts and delighting millions of players across the world. We also happen to be very big fans of Ticket to Ride. We remember playing the board game with family and friends long before we started our Marmalade journey and we had so many ideas for how to bring it to life and create a solid foundation that would allow us to evolve it for many years to come. 

We have created a new game that we are incredibly proud of. We have a brand new engine, a new adaptive AI system, multiple ways to play, improved graphics and updated codebase which enables our future roadmap. We know the game has had some issues for some users (see next question) but we are fixing them and soon it will be the best and most complete Ticket to Ride game imaginable. 

In conclusion, we, Marmalade, are absolutely not charging anyone twice. We are offering owners of Classic Edition the Europe map for free as a good will gesture, but we can’t restore purchases from that game because they are not our purchases to restore. We are very excited about the game we just released and have years worth of plans to support it and enhance it with both maps and features that the community is requesting. We are committed to serving the players to the best of our ability and hope to convert everyone into passionate fans going forward. 

2: Can you talk about the stability issues in the game?
(By Nessorat, dalaczek, faintzog, Sam, gotravelwithstaci)

It’s an unfortunate but unavoidable fact of game development that no game will ever be bug free. Unfortunately, our new Ticket to Ride was not an exception and a small segment of our players did experience stability issues when we launched the game. Normally we would release a patch as soon as possible (same or next day in some cases) and fix the problem in order to not let it impact people’s experiences any longer than necessary. However, in spite of our entire dev team, our entire 10 person strong QA team plus two external QA agencies working together around the clock, a few weeks passed without us being able to reproduce the issues that players were complaining about. We ended up implementing a whole new online reporting system that enabled players to submit logs to us so we could see exactly what was happening on their devices and, with this help from the community, we were eventually able to fix the problems. We are very sorry it took so long to get to the bottom of this, but we promise you it wasn’t for a lack of trying and everyone was doing everything humanly possible to improve the situation. We are extremely grateful to the players who patiently helped us identify the issues and ultimately enabled us to fix them. 

From all the data the platforms provide to us, as well as from our own analytics and telemetry, we see that the vast majority of our users are enjoying the game and all its modes with no issues. We know that for the few users experiencing issues, the fact that tens of thousands of people are managing to play problem free is of little help. We continue to work hard to investigate any issue reported by anyone. This is work that never stops for game developers and we want to reassure you we are committed to bringing each and every one of you the best possible experience. 

3: How did you decide what features to focus on at launch?
(By Mark, Linda, Steven, Liz, Catherine, Christi)

When we acquired the Ticket to Ride licence, we knew the community had strong views on what the Classic Edition did right and what could be improved. We have been fortunate to work with this community throughout development and to be able to talk to some (sadly not all) of the top players in the Classic’s Hall of Fame. These players are the best in the world and were able to provide crucial insights into what they needed from the game. More widely though, Asmodee and Days of Wonder have been fantastic partners and shared all their learnings from the feedback they had gathered over the years from the entire user base, both casual and competitive. From all this research, several things came out. 

The first priority that emerged was the need to significantly improve the AI. In both our game, and in the Twin Sails version, the majority of users only ever play single player against bots and one of the key areas that people wanted us to focus on was making the bots more life-like and smarter. We came up with an adaptive AI system that we’re very proud of, which adapts to the way the game is being played in order to ensure a good experience, regardless of how you personally like to play the game. We ran countless simulations and tweaked it endlessly and, like all good AI, the best thing about it is that it constantly evolves. Based on game stats, we are also nudging it in the right direction on an ongoing basis, so we are confident it will only get better. 

Another significant area of focus was the look and feel of the game. The feedback we got was that players wanted a fresher, more exciting experience, with animations and immersive details, rather than just having to look at the board game map all the time. We have delivered this, but when we released the game we noticed that the more hardcore segment of our audience actually preferred the pared back look of the old game and didn’t appreciate the distraction of the animations. We then removed a lot of the animations based on this feedback and we got swamped with emails from the more casual segment of our audience demanding that we bring the animations back. This is a hard balance between readability and immersion. The board game map may be a more readable option, but what makes it clear and easy to digest is also what makes it flat and not exciting enough to the majority of players. We are still working on getting this balance right and considering various options to satisfy both the hardcore and the casual ends of the spectrum. 

The main thing people seemed to appreciate about the Classic Edition was the variety of gameplay that 10 years worth of map expansions provided. This is something we absolutely aim to match and exceed in way less than 10 years. For launch we choose to prioritise the most popular content and features, but we have a very aggressive roadmap with multiple updates coming out this year. We look forward to making them available to the public as soon as they’re ready for release. And while we’re on the topic of variety of gameplay, we are also excited about the prospect of bringing to life some of the physical board game maps that have never made their way into the digital space before. 

4. When will those who bought the "Round the World Ticket" get new content? Can you give more details on what map is coming out and when? 
(By ThatDeafDude, mosier.wes, rysher, Yborx, bostondvd, elangab, Portcitybob) 

Players who own the Round the World Ticket have access to the first 10 map expansions that we will release. They had the Europe map from the beginning and the next big one is the Nordic map, which will be released in a matter of days. The reason we don’t communicate the plans around maps in more detail is because the detail tends to change and evolve. The roadmap is quite flexible. We have capacity to release several maps this year for instance, one every 2-3 months, but the details of what those maps will be are not finalised. They change based on what we hear from our players, but also on data that we receive periodically about what is popular in the physical board game. We want to provide you with maps that were popular in the Classic game, but also with new exclusive ones that have never been brought to the digital platforms before. Watch this space!

5. When are you releasing local play? Will it need a companion app?
(By LordStrikerGTR, rysher, dius00)

Local play with companion app is actually our favourite way to play! We think it’s the perfect hybrid between recreating the social aspect of the board game and the automation and immersion of a video game. We are committed to releasing both pass and play on device and local play enabled by a companion app this year. Pass and play will allow you to play on the same device with your friends and family, without the need for a companion app. This will be released first, in the next few months. 

Later in the year, we are planning to launch the game on consoles. Either at launch or very soon after that, we will release a free companion app. This will allow you to play on the big screen, with everyone in the same room controlling their cards via their mobile phones, through this companion app. 

6. Will there be any kind of player ranking or levels in the game?
(By Rafiathos, Leviatrain, soda)

This is one of the most exciting features we are working on at the moment. We recognise the need for progression and the validation that you get from seeing that you’ve reached the next level. It also adds a lot to multiplayer games if you know you won against someone of a much higher rank for instance. We were disappointed we couldn’t deliver this for launch, but we really want to get it right. We are working on a feature that will give you all the competitive aspects and allow you to celebrate improving your skill. All we can say at this stage is that it is coming and it’s probably coming sooner than you think. 

7. How big is your team and what are they working on?
(By Yborx)

The Ticket to Ride team is about 30 people and is split into 3 smaller development teams, each working on exciting things that you will enjoy this year. 

We have a team working on the core game. Their main focus is releasing new features and optimising and improving the experience for all our players. We already talked about some of the exciting features they are busy working on, like leaderboards, pass and play and so on. They are also the unsung heroes chasing and fixing issues reported by the community or by our QA. The artists in this team are the ones constantly tweaking the graphics in an effort to hit the right balance between readability and immersion, like we mentioned earlier.

There is a second team working on the content roadmap. They are designers and producers who analyse data and work out what the next map should be. They are joined by artists who then make the beautiful art for the map, as well as the trains, locomotives, cards, tickets and characters. Finally, the programmers on the team focus on gameplay, integration and evolving the AI system to learn to play the new map as realistically as possible. 

The third team is responsible for the console releases we have planned for later in the year. This is a significant development effort, but also requires a lot of art and UI/UX work to ensure the experience plays well on each platform. A mobile interface doesn’t work on PlayStation for instance, so we need to create all these from scratch for each platform. One other aspect that they focus on and that we’re very proud of is that our games allow cross platform multiplayer, enabling people on all platforms to play together. Ticket to Ride will be no exception. 

These are the 3 main teams working on Ticket to Ride, but they are supported by multiple other teams in the company, like a back-end team who helps with all things Bubble for any game in the company, a QA team that checks each build for bugs, two very talented Community and Customer Support teams who have helped keep the communication channels open between us and the people who play our game and, last but not least, a Marketing and Publishing team who ensures each release is accompanied by all the right trailers and screenshots, all translated and cut to the right sizes for all devices and so on. 

8. Could you talk about some of the ways that developing this game has been different from the other games in your library?
(By bostondvd)

Excellent question! There are two main things that come to mind. First of all, the biggest difference has to be the community. This was the first time we got to work with such a passionate community, who cared so much about the game and genuinely wanted to help. We are in awe of the wonderful people who took every opportunity to engage with us, to voice their wants and desires, but also their concerns when they felt things weren’t working out the way they hoped. The many volunteers who helped us write the AI system and then played against it giving us feedback are something we just haven’t seen before. The game would be very different if it wasn’t for your detailed and valuable input. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you! And thank you for continuing to work with us every day and sharing your thoughts on new features and priorities. You are truly spectacular!

The community involvement helped us understand that Ticket to Ride needs to cater to a wide audience and hit the right balance between accessibility and immersion because not all passionate fans want the same things. A classic example is the AI, which incorporates so many tactical options in order to give experienced players a proper challenge, but this can’t come at the expense of it being fun to play with. It also meant we needed to learn a new way to develop the game, which wasn’t at all like developing any of our previous games. We had to get comfortable with things changing based on recent intel and to leave room in our planning for reacting to the requests and feedback. This is quite different from a standard development, where planning tends to be more structured and regimented. It’s been a blast and it continues to be very fun and engaging for us. It’s also incredibly rewarding to have this direct connection with the players because we don’t feel like we’re developing the game in isolation. We couldn’t be more grateful. 

The second biggest difference is probably the fact that for the first time ever we have been able to work directly with the creators of the board game. Our portfolio includes many popular board games who became classic over decades and, as expected, their original creators are no longer around. Being able to talk regularly to the Days of Wonder team has been hugely helpful in our process. On a personal note, we have to admit some of us have been quite star struck while doing this because at the end of the day, we are also just huge nerdy fans of this amazing board game, which we have been playing for so, so long without any idea that one day we will be making a video game out of it. It was quite a special experience.

9. Who made the music choice? Why did you take this direction? 
(By retromac29, TVs Frank)

We think music is a crucial part of the experience and helps with the immersion. As such, we do a lot of research to understand where each game is set (each map in Ticket to Ride’s case), what was the music, what were the authentic instruments in the relevant region and era. We invest a lot into ensuring that we have bespoke music, created specifically for each game/expansion, music that is unique and captures the essence of the experience. The Ticket to Ride music, like the music in all our games, is created by a multi awarded Hollywood composer called Christopher Willis, with whom we’ve had a very long relationship. 

10. What is your vision for Bubble?
(By bostondvd)

With Bubble we are creating a social platform for board games. The ultimate vision is that you could have a game agnostic account that holds all your stats, all your details, your friends and your chats in one place and you take this identity with you in any board game that supports it. It is now in various stages of completeness in the several games that enable it, but we are working towards a unified ecosystem of board games that can be played seamlessly by a group of friends moving from one game to the other. 

Ticket to Ride has the back end foundations of Bubble and will continue to receive updates that bring more features into the experience. 

11. How many hours have the CEOs spent playing the classic version? Have they ever played the board game? What are some of the things they like better in the new version than in the classic? (By hplayer935)

Between the two of us, we have about 400 hours in our game and more in the Twin Sails version, accumulated throughout the years. We are both big fans of the board game, which we have been playing for more than a decade. The two versions of the digital game are difficult to compare because they are two fundamentally different products, which set out to achieve very different things. 

The Classic Edition aims to be an extension of the board game, that passionate fans can pick up on the go when they don’t have anyone to play the board game with. It offers an experience as close as possible to the board game. While being very comforting and familiar to dedicated board game fans, this comes at the expense of casual players and new fans who aren’t as familiar with the physical board game and who feel like this isn’t a game for them. 

Our version aims to bring the board game to life, to bridge the gap between competitive and casual and to offer an experience that satisfies both ends of the spectrum. We made a game that you can use to introduce friends and family to Ticket to Ride without the fuss of setting up the board and without the need to be in the same physical space. People who have never played the board game should be able to pick our game up and find it accessible and fun. As mentioned earlier, this is a balance that we are still tweaking and we’ll continue to release improvements and features that will cater to as wide an audience as possible. 

[hr][/hr]
Thank you once again to everyone for your engagement! Our CEOs have put their best efforts into addressing as many questions as possible, but If you have any additional questions, our community team is always here for you, whether through Steam, Discord, Social Media or even via email at help@marmalademail.com. 

Please keep sharing your thoughts, ideas, and experiences—we're here to listen and learn from you as we continue this journey together!

– Bella & Davi, Community Team

notes.title: CEO Q&A: Join the Conversation on Ticket to Ride
notes.content:
Hello travellers! 

We're thrilled to announce a special event for our community: a Q&A session with our CEOs at Marmalade Game Studio! This is your golden ticket to gain exclusive insights, learn about the inspiration behind the game, and discover what's in store for the future of Ticket to Ride.

What you can expect: 

🛤️Laying The Tracks: Steam ahead into the decision-making process that led to the creation of Ticket to Ride. Our CEOs, Cristina Mereuta and Mike Willis, will take you on a journey through the backstory, sharing the inspiration, challenges, and passion that fueled the development of this iconic game.

🚅Express Route: Explore the intricacies of Ticket to Ride's game mechanics, design philosophy, and the strategic elements that make it a captivating experience for players worldwide. Learn about the improvements and changes we've implemented since launch based on our community’s feedback, and get an inside look into the ongoing evolution of the game.

🗺️Future Destinations: Curious about what lies ahead for Ticket to Ride? Join us as we discuss upcoming updates, expansions, and the exciting developments planned for Ticket to Ride. Find out what's on the horizon and be part of shaping the game's future.

Submit Your Questions Today!

We invite you to submit your questions, suggestions, and anything else you'd like to know in the comments below. Our CEOs will be answering the most frequently asked and thought-provoking questions you may have, making this Q&A session the perfect opportunity for you to steer the conversation in the direction you're most curious about. And mark your calendars, because on March 18, 2024, we'll be sharing the CEOs' responses right here on Steam for you to check out at your convenience. 

So, don your conductor's hat and send your questions below by Friday, March 15, 2024. 

We can’t wait to hear from you!

– Bella & Davi, Community Team

notes.title: Patch Version 1.1.2
notes.content:
Hello, travellers! 

Our team has been working tirelessly behind the scenes to bring you the latest improvements and enhancements to your favourite railway adventure. Today, we are thrilled to share Ticket to Ride Patch 1.1.2. Let’s take a look at the exciting updates this patch brings:


 Achievements! We know that many of you have been eagerly awaiting this feature. We're excited to be able to recognise and celebrate your strategic triumphs, and this is the perfect way to do just that!
 Your train cards now move down to indicate that it's not your turn.
 More consistent button placement when claiming routes, to ensure the buttons are never offscreen.
 New turn timer visuals!
 Tweaked turn timer durations (blitz and async modes).
 Added a greater variety of trains to the main menu animation.
 The destination ticket display will now respect the fact that stations can only be used to share a single route when marking tickets as completed with stations.
 Memory and performance optimisations for the main menu.
 Fixed a camera zoom issue when resuming a game.
 Fixed various lobby issues which caused some users problems when their internet connection was unstable
 Fixed reconnection issues which sometimes caused problems for opponents 


Thank you for being part of our community! We're excited to share the upcoming adventures with you!

notes.title: Patch Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello, travellers!

We’re excited to bring you the latest update for Ticket to Ride, featuring several fixes and improvements based on your valuable feedback. As always, thank you for your active engagement in the community!

This update includes:


 New camera controls! Experience the game from every angle and take control by zooming in and out on the map.
 AI opponents can now be added to Online With Friends (OWF) mode again.
 Added greater map pin variety to handle cases where a player has lots of incomplete destination tickets.
 Enhanced track colours so they can be more easily seen on the maps. 
 Fixes for disconnection issues in multiplayer games.
 Fixes for issues causing game interruptions and invalid moves.
 Improved handling of network issues mid-game for seamless reconnection.
 Fixes to lobby-related issues, including colour conflicts and incorrect status text.
 Improved AI behaviour, specifically in the Europe map.
 Fixes for an issue preventing players from reopening their destination tickets panel.
 Fixes for issues with bubble chat, friend requests and invites.

That's all for now, but our work continues! We look forward to your ongoing participation on our community forums and Discord as we strive to make Ticket to Ride the best it can be.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.18
notes.content:
Greetings, travellers!

We've been closely listening to your concerns regarding multiplayer disconnection issues, and we want to assure you that your feedback is incredibly valuable to us. In response to these concerns, we've temporarily disabled AI opponents in Online With Friends (OWF) games to isolate and address this issue. This measure aims to enhance the overall stability of the game as we work on a fix.

This update includes:


 Temporary deactivation of AI opponents in Online With Friends games.

We genuinely appreciate your patience and understanding during this process. Your support means the world to us.

We encourage you to continue sharing your thoughts. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please contact us via the Community Hub or our Discord server.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.17
notes.content:
Hello, travellers! We're excited to bring you the latest updates and fixes to Ticket to Ride. Here's a breakdown of what’s new in this patch:

Bug Fixes:


 Making sure players can see the results of async games that ended while they weren't online.
 Fixed the issue with AI attempting to pick a card from an invalid card pile.
 Fixed an issue with quick game mode which could put you into an empty game.
 Fixed several issues that could cause disconnections for players in multiplayer mode. 
 Fixed the issue that could prevent you from re-entering a game where one of your opponents had previously disconnected.
 Fixed several issues that could result in illegal moves being recorded in multiplayer matches.
 Fixed several issues that could result in moves being made for the player before their timer has expired.
 Fixed several issues that could cause the game to get stuck at initial ticket selection.
 Fixed issues with the previous resign logic implementation.

As always, thank you for your support and feedback! We invite you to continue sharing your thoughts, suggestions, and experiences on our community forums or via our Discord server.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.16
notes.content:
Hello, travellers!

We're excited to bring you a new update. Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback!

Here's what's new in version 1.0.16:

 Implemented extra logging capabilities to help us identify and address issues related to connectivity more effectively.
 Reverted specific fixes that inadvertently caused crashes in the game's front end, particularly with notifications in the "My Games" section, impacting the overall stability.
We will continue to work diligently behind the scenes, conducting thorough quality assurance testing and actively addressing any issues that may arise. We genuinely appreciate your patience and understanding during this time.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.15
notes.content:
Greetings, travellers!

Thank you for consistently reporting any bugs you find in Ticket to Ride – we've been hard at work addressing these key issues for you. We're pleased to introduce some updates in this latest submission build. 

Improvements:


 Show Player Info Toggle: The "Show Player Info" toggle is now fully functional. Easily view player information at your convenience and strategize your moves with clarity.
 Turn Notifications in "My Games": Players will now receive timely notifications in the "My Games" section, reminding them when it's their turn to make their move.
 Improved Softlock Errors: We've made improvements in addressing softlock errors during initial ticket selection.
 Reduced Start-of-Game Issues: While the issue of players getting stuck at the start with only the settings button visible is still present for some users, we've lowered the reproducibility rate in this new build. You should encounter this less frequently. Our team remains dedicated to further addressing and resolving this matter.

We appreciate your patience and dedication as we strive to make your experience the best it can be. 

We'll see you on the tracks!

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.14
notes.content:
Hello, travellers!

We've been attentively listening to your feedback and understand that some of you are experiencing gameplay and visual issues that have been affecting your experience. Your insights are crucial to us, and we want to assure you that your concerns have not gone unnoticed. We appreciate the patience and understanding you've demonstrated during these times. 

In this update, we've focused on addressing some of the key issues that have been raised, and while we acknowledge there's still work to be done, we believe this release takes a significant step towards improving your overall gaming experience.

Improvements:

 Resolved a persistent issue causing games to get stuck at initial ticket selection in all modes.
 Fixed AI players occasionally selecting fewer than 2 starting tickets when playing on the Europe map.

In the upcoming sprint, our development team is committed to tackling more gameplay-related bugs. We are initiating a comprehensive process of reproducing the bugs reported by our community to gather detailed logs and prioritise fixes. 

Your feedback has been instrumental in guiding our efforts. We appreciate your continued patience and understanding as we work towards delivering a smoother and more polished gaming experience.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Ticket to Ride 2024 Express: Official Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello fellow travellers,

First things first – WOW! The energy you've been pouring into our game is absolutely mind-blowing. We've been reading all your messages, feedback, and even the occasional train-related pun (keep 'em coming – we love a good chuckle!), and we’re genuinely grateful for your support. But, dear passengers, our adventure is far from over! 

Q4 2023 & Q1 2024: 

✅ Skipping Animations: Enjoy a faster game with the option to off in-game animations.
✅ New Camera Controls: Experience the game from every angle and take control by zooming in and out on the map.
✅ A New Expansion: Discover new routes, challenges, and adventures, including new characters, locomotives, and carriages with the Nordic Expansion! 
✅ Achievements: Challenge yourself to unlock a variety of Steam Achievements and showcase your mastery of Ticket to Ride to the world.

Additionally, experience smoother gameplay with our commitment to ongoing bug fixes and patch notes.

Q2 2024


✅ Mac Release: It's here! Enjoy the classic railway adventure on your Mac and dive into hours of strategic fun. 
✅ Simplified Map View! In response to community feedback, toggle between the existing map view and a new, simplified version for improved accessibility and readability.
✅ 1910 and 1912 Ticket Packs: Experience new gameplay mechanics with two new content packs, each adding new tickets and 3 new game modes. Add new challenges and strategies to your game, without the need for a new map.
✅  Leaderboards / Rankings: Show off your skills, compare your progress with friends, and strive to reach the top spot as you master the railways.
✅  Pass & Play: Play with your friends and family using a single device. 
🔜 A New Expansion: Embark on an exciting new adventure that includes:
- A brand new map!
- Locomotive Pack: Customise your locomotives with a new pack to add a personal touch to your railways.
- Character Pack: Explore a fresh personality and play style with our character pack.

Onwards 2024 


Local Play: Enjoy the laid-back fun of playing a local game around a main screen, with each player on their mobile device. 
 Bubble: Immerse yourself in a more socially interactive gaming experience with:
- In-Game Chat and Voice Chat: communicate effortlessly with friends and groups.
 Metagame: Embark on an epic journey as Ticket to Ride introduces a narrative element, offering you additional challenges, objectives, and interactions that go beyond the standard gameplay.
 More Expansions, Locomotive Packs and Character Packs!

Our commitment to Ticket to Ride continues into the future, as we've always done with all our other titles throughout the years.

Priorities in our roadmap might evolve over time, but our community will continue to play a crucial role in shaping the direction of the game. Stay tuned for more surprises, updates, and content additions throughout 2024 and beyond.

Share your thoughts!

Follow us on Steam to receive our announcements, join our community to chat with us and stay up to date with news and events, and stay connected with us on social media for the latest updates:

🔷 Discord
🔷 Instagram
🔷 X / Twitter
🔷 Facebook

Thank you for being the fuel in our locomotive as we steam through this adventure together! 🚆

– Bella, Community Manager
